title: feat(spec,i18n): register the delete_package platform tool and label it in every pack (cloud#3656)
body:
Fixes #31020

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:平台工具名单 `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai-studio']` 登记了 `delete_package`,十种界面语言都补上了这一步的显示名(中文「删除一个应用包」)。
- **为什么改**:cloud 新增的「删除环境里搭的应用包」工具(只发起删除,由人确认)要求在平台名单里登记;不登记,cloud 的工具名一致性测试一直是红的(objectstack-ai/cloud#3686)。
- **风险与回滚**:风险很低——只是名单里多一个名字、语言包里多一行文字,不改任何结构或行为;回滚即撤掉这一个 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts`(新名字的位置与注释);`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts`(中文措辞);`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/toolLabels-locale-parity-7481.test.ts`,预期全部通过(每种语言都有 `delete_package` 的显示名)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **spec** — `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai-studio']` gains `delete_package` in its sorted place (after `delete_field`), and the group's docblock says what the tool is: it only stages the removal of a package built in the environment, and a person confirms before anything is deleted (objectstack-ai/cloud#3656). `PLATFORM_PROVIDED_TOOL_NAMES` therefore carries it, so a skill whose `tools[]` names `delete_package` resolves under ADR-0109 reference integrity.
- **i18n** — `chatbot.tool.delete_package` in all ten `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/` packs, worded like the sibling `delete_field` / `create_package` labels: en "Delete a package", zh 「删除一个应用包」, ar "حذف حزمة", de "Ein Paket löschen", es "Eliminar un paquete", fr "Supprimer un paquet", ja 「パッケージを削除する」, ko 「패키지 삭제하기」, pt "Excluir um pacote", ru "Удалить пакет".
- Two `patch` changesets (`@objectstack/spec`, `@object-ui/i18n`), each carrying both declaration lines.

Consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#3686 (cloud#3656) — its `platform-tool-names-conformance.test.ts` goes green once a cloud pin round carries this change. Same file set as the cloud record-write precedent (eca7cd2008) minus its chatbot card work, which this tool does not need.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.test.ts` — 5/5 (snake_case, no cross-package collision, no family-prefix shadowing, sorted groups).
- `ui` — `toolLabels-locale-parity-7481`, `toolLabels-sentences-12724` and the whole `packages/i18n/` suite: Test Files 99 passed (99), Tests 1549 passed / 13 skipped, against a rebuilt spec `dist` that carries `delete_package` (so the parity suite read the new name from the registry, not a stale build).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `delete_package` is not added to `PLATFORM_DESTRUCTIVE_TOOL_NAMES` in `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`. That set is a by-name fallback for platform tools that carry no `requiresConfirmation`; a tool outside it gets no `destructiveHint`, which MCP reads as its own default `true`. `remove_sample_data` (the precedent's destructive tool) is not in it either. No change needed for this card.

## Verification

- 73 families exit 0 (all `packages/spec` checks incl. `check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:docs`, `check:export-origins`, `check:liveness`; `check:nul-bytes`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:published-files`, the changeset gates, and the rest of the list).

They read built `dist/` of packages this diff does not touch; CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs them on a built tree.
- NOT MEASURED, reason: prerequisite not built (exit 1) — `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 169/170 files pass; the one failure is `unit-registry-absence-collision` refusing because `@objectstack/client` has no `dist/` here (37 import failures, all that one package). CI's `Test UI` owns it.
